known_failed_procedures.finding: Partial contaminated-example comparison; weak-cue recall, failed-action omission and malformed-plan interruption.
Old lexical encounter recovered; significant failed invitation still omitted; visible-neighbor plan unnecessarily rejected.
Complete formation/recall, but unsupported simulation/participation and lost earlier uncertainty in generated factual memory.
Second model review still adopted a human market encounter as voice-body autobiography; stopped with pending work intact.
Exact factual capture, but free-form receiving answers still misidentified body/knowledge and omitted qualifications; invalid provider JSON interrupted and was resumed.
Free-form answer converted unobserved recipient access into definite non-receipt, despite a subsequent uncertainty qualifier.
Complete 15/16 evidence coverage per arm; acknowledgment lesson was retained but not retrieved. Provider 429 interruption resumed without recapture.
No invented negatives, but proposed surname response discarded the known human-report context along with the unknown surname. Strict coverage 2/3, not 3/3.
Both surname contexts preserved. Baseline unsupported-launch response used a five-empty-array shape twice; pending evidence retained, then safe shape normalization and resumption completed it.

acceptance.meaningful_unsuccessful_action_retained_: pass, invitation and separate chart handover
acceptance.invalid_plan_or_json_preserves_pending_q: pass, mechanical regression and observed resumptions

limitations: No new complete 16-question run under final v6 contract: unchanged valid cases reused and affected cases rerun in paired frozen-condition receiving contexts.
Exact attributed evidence is qualified; generated free-form narration remains unqualified.
One formation sample per arm and synthetic dates do not establish statistical superiority or ten years of live continuity.
Three consolidation passes, correction/support reconciliation, portable exact-content closure and live receiving-harness acceptance remain later stages.
Duplicate source blocks and extra selected support remain measured organization/compression work, not hidden noise admission.
